title: Dungeon Now Loading + Better Combat Compat
description: Makes missing weapons from Dungeon Now Loading work with Better Combat mod.
body:
BetterCombat x Dungeon Now Loading | This is a datapack that offers compatibility between the  Dungeon Now Loading weapon that was missing and Better Combat.

⚙️ Compatibility
- Dungeon Now Loading
- Better Combat

You may need a datapack loader mod to use it for modpacks, such as Paxi.
